movers.headline: secures a Rs 156.61 cr order from Nalanda Engicon for design, supply, erection, testing and commissioning of Power Supply Installations (TSS, SP, SSP), 24-month execution
assigns its leasehold rights in land and conveys the building constructed on it to Anand Rathi Towers for Rs 145.00 cr, completed the same day
accepts MIDC's offer of 30.16-acre leasehold industrial land at Butibori Ph-2, Nagpur, for Rs 66.35 cr, to build a new 5,000 MTPA NdFeB permanent-magnet plant
secures a Rs 38.64 cr power-cable purchase order from an undisclosed Indian energy-infrastructure and transmission company, deliverable by 31-Mar-2027
dispatches its Letter of Offer for a Rs 29.00 cr tender-offer buyback of 1,44,639 shares (2.38% of paid-up capital) at Rs 2,005 each, opening 3-Nov
approves Rs 25 cr to expand WOS Monga Strayfield's precision-engineering capacity at Pune for data-centre and power-infrastructure enclosures, over 6-9 months
sells leasehold rights on 5.28 acres of non-operational land at IKP Knowledge Park, Medchal, to Sai Life Sciences for Rs 19.80 cr
receives a confirmed Rs 9.25 cr order from Samsung Data System India for AV displays across 90 automotive showrooms, with 5-year maintenance

order_wins: **Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works** -- its largest-ever order: a 3-year, Rs 303.17 cr maintenance-dredging contract from New Mangalore Port Authority, bid ~10.16% below the next lowest rival (mcap not in store; ratio not computable).
**Oswal Pumps** -- a further Rs 235.92 cr order from MSEDCL for 10,000 more Off-Grid Solar Photovoltaic Water Pumping Systems under PM-KUSUM-B (mcap not in store; filed twice, carried once).
**Goodluck India** -- subsidiary Goodluck Defence and Aerospace secures a Rs 58.20 cr order for 155mm HE ERFB shell casings; counterparty withheld for confidentiality (mcap not in store).

**Gayatri Projects** -- wins a Rs 342 cr B-RIDE joint-venture contract to build formation works, bridges and viaduct on Corridor-4 of the Bengaluru Suburban Transport Project (JV share not stated; mcap n/a).
**Venus Pipes & Tubes** -- Rs 29 cr pipe-spooling order from a data-centre customer, part of an earlier Rs 185 cr Letter of Intent; the balance to convert in phases.
**Leapfrog Engineering Services** -- a USD 1.301 mn order from Spetco Middle East for specialised instrumentation cables (no rupee equivalent stated in the filing).
**Subex** -- a USD 0.72 mn AI Agent-Squads deployment with a Tier-1 African telecom operator, for fraud investigation and revenue-assurance root-cause analysis.
**Arabian Petroleum** -- a ~Rs 5 cr purchase order from HPCL for additive supply at its Mazgaon TML Lubes plant.
**TeleCanor Global** -- bills USD 240,000 (~Rs 2.28 cr; ~10.6% of mcap) as the first milestone on a PrimeZen Innovations crypto-exchange-software order; the total order value is yet to be confirmed.
**Novus Loyalty** -- a 3-year agreement to supply digital rewards to TLG India (Publicis Re:sources); value not disclosed.
**Dhruv Consultancy Services** -- with Designilla, wins a Rs 2.84 cr NHAI Letter of Acceptance for Supervision Consultant Services on the Moga-Tallewal section of NH-71, Punjab.
**Vision Infra Equipment Solutions** -- Rs 20.00 cr work order for hot-mix-plant production and bituminous-mix laying for an Indian counterparty (not named in the filing).
**Railtel Corporation of India** -- Rs 20.04 cr purchase order from The Pune District Central Co-Operative Bank for an integrated surveillance system and CCTV-inventory buy-back.
**Waaree Renewable Technologies** -- Letter of Award for EPC works on a 200 MW/500 MWh Battery Energy Storage Project; value not disclosed.
**Zenith Drugs** -- awarded a Rs 0.73 cr tender by Uttar Pradesh Medical Supplies Corporation for 11.87 lakh units of Betamethasone Valerate cream.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Kanel Industries** -- fixes rights-issue terms: 54 shares for every 10 held, at Rs 39.95 each (incl. Rs 29.95 premium), raising up to Rs 16.99 cr.
**Ola Electric Mobility** -- closes the issue period of its already-approved Rs 1,000 cr rights issue, opened 22-Oct; no new amount.
**Aptus Pharma** -- receives BSE's in-principle approval for a preferential issue approved by shareholders in September; terms not yet fixed.

**Flywings Simulator Training Centre** -- Board approves a proposed Rs 68.20 cr preferential warrant issue to promoter and public allottees, subject to shareholder approval (new_warrant, proposed stage).
equity_allotments: **String Metaverse** -- allots 1.68 cr new preferential equity shares at Rs 8.85 each to 14 allottees, raising Rs 14.83 cr (filed twice, carried once).
**Aanchal Ispat** -- allots 7.27 lakh fresh warrants at Rs 82 to promoter Mukesh Goel, Rs 5.96 cr, 25% (Rs 1.49 cr) paid upfront (filed twice, carried once).

**Jio Financial Services** -- allots 25 cr equity shares to promoter-group entities Sikka Ports and Jamnagar Utilities on conversion of past warrants, lifting promoter-group holding from 49.13% to 50.98% (warrant conversion past).
**Sammaan Capital** -- promoter Avenir Investment RSC converts Tranche-I warrants into 8.69 cr equity shares at Rs 139 each, paying the remaining Rs 905.86 cr (warrant conversion past).
**Embassy Developments** -- allots 93.19 lakh equity shares at Rs 111.51 on conversion of the remaining Oct-12 warrant tranche to promoter group entity Embassy Property Developments (~Rs 103.93 cr).
**Kross** -- allots 15 lakh new preferential equity shares at Rs 212 (Rs 31.80 cr) plus a matching 15-lakh new convertible-warrant tranche at the same price (new_share_allotment + new_warrant).
**Taurian MPS** -- allots the balance 2.31 lakh equity shares at Rs 419 (Rs 9.69 cr) of an already-approved preferential issue, plus 8.49 lakh new convertible warrants.
**Swaraj Suiting** -- allots 4.65 lakh equity shares on warrant conversion at Rs 236 (incl. Rs 226 premium), receiving the balance Rs 8.23 cr (warrant conversion past).
**Rollatainers** -- issues 22.42 cr new convertible warrants at Rs 2.23 to promoter and non-promoter allottees, up to Rs 50.00 cr, 25% (Rs 12.50 cr) received now (new_warrant).
**Connplex Cinemas** -- allots 8 lakh new convertible warrants at Rs 233.05 to non-promoters, Rs 18.64 cr, per its 9-Oct EGM approval (new_warrant).
**Kaya** -- allots 18.24 lakh new preferential equity shares at Rs 274.10 to Axana Estates and Plutus Investments India, Rs 50.00 cr (new_share_allotment).
**Lead Reclaim and Rubber Products** -- allots 7.88 lakh equity shares at Rs 75 on warrant conversion, Rs 5.91 cr -- our arithmetic -- (warrant conversion past).
m_and_a: **Aeroflex Neu** -- enters wire-and-cable manufacturing, acquiring 55% of Aerolex Cables (Rs 55.16 cr FY26 turnover) for Rs 31.00 cr, with further tranches to follow.
**Brainbees Solutions (FirstCry)** -- material subsidiary Globalbees buys a further 14.23% of JW Brands for Rs 18.68 cr, lifting its stake to 89.33%.
**Skipper** -- acquires 100% of Sansha Fastener, which becomes a wholly owned subsidiary (value not disclosed).
**Ace Alpha Tech** -- Board approves amalgamating itself, as a going concern, with Share India Securities; share-swap ratio and other terms still to be finalised by the Board.
**Taneja Aerospace & Aviation** -- approves amalgamating WOS Katra Auto Engineering into itself from 1-Apr-2027, reviving a May-2024 proposal it had earlier shelved (filed twice, carried once).
**Ekansh Concepts** -- receives BSE's no-objection on its already-disclosed (Jun-2026) merger of Sankalp Industrial Infratech into itself; NCLT sanction still pending.
⚑ **Goodricke Group** -- signs a non-binding MoU to sell its Barnesbeg Tea Estate (0.25% of turnover) for Rs 5.00 cr, subject to due diligence, definitive agreement expected by 31-Jan-2027.
**SJ Corporation** -- WOS Fishfa Rubbers to invest up to Rs 7.56 cr (~SGD 1.01 mn) in Singapore's Travia Consultancy Services via convertible instruments (filed twice, carried once; ~0.9% of mcap).

**Tata Motors** -- completes the initial settlement of its tender offer for Iveco Group N.V.; WOS TML CV Holdings now holds 89.42% of Iveco, which becomes an indirect subsidiary (deal value not stated in this filing).
**Network18 Media & Investments** -- NCLT approves the merger of News18 Marathi into the Company, effective pending regulatory approval (disclosed within its Q2 FY27 results release).

**Nazara Technologies** -- pays a second USD 77.00 mn (~Rs 734.35 cr) tranche toward its already-disclosed Bluetile/Bestplay acquisition (total consideration USD 303.02 mn / ~Rs 2,990 cr); the balance is yet to be paid.

⚑ **Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri** -- promoter Shrikant Gopaldas Zaveri discloses an off-market sale of 50.06% of the Company on 30-Oct, part of an aggregate 74.12% promoter-family stake sale; buyer and price are not stated in the cached pages (3 of 37 pages read) -- a likely change-of-control, unconfirmed.
**Oriental Aromatics** -- enters a strategic, manufacturing and technical tie-up with Unilever Industries; terms not disclosed in the cached pages.
**Apar Industries** -- WOS Petroleum Specialities Pte Ltd to acquire 70% of Hebei Jinghuan Cable (China), which had nil turnover in FY2025; consideration not disclosed.
**Fidel Softech** -- agrees to acquire 100% of Softenger (India) and Soft Data Middle Eastern IT Solutions, subject to closing conditions; consideration not disclosed.

**GAIL (India)** -- Board approves transferring six City Gas Distribution areas (Varanasi, Patna, Ranchi, East Singhbhum, Cuttack, Khordha) to WOS GAIL Gas via slump sale/Business Transfer Agreement, effective 1-Jan-2027; consideration not stated in the cached pages.
capex_core: **Midwest Energy** -- see Top movers: Rs 66.35 cr MIDC land purchase for a new NdFeB magnet plant at Nagpur.
**Kilburn Engineering** -- see Top movers: Rs 25 cr Monga Strayfield Pune precision-engineering expansion (filed twice, carried once).
**Patel Retail** -- adds 20,000 sq ft of covered space at its Ambernath distribution centre, Rs 2 cr via internal accruals.
**Delhivery** -- invests up to Rs 36 cr in new WOS Delhivery Fintech Distribution, to fund fintech-product distribution to truckers and last-mile agents.

**Elevate Campuses** -- WOS GHS Sonipat II to acquire two more hostel blocks and allied mess/laundry/security services at O.P. Jindal Global University, Sonipat (10,500 beds in all), subject to due diligence; consideration not stated in the cached pages.

**Vinati Organics** -- Board approves an aggregate Rs 500 cr capex plan (with WOS Veeral Organics) for greenfield specialty-chemicals capacity -- resins, fragrances, water treatment, oilfield -- funded via internal accruals, to be commissioned within two years.
business_updates: **Results season** -- 365 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations), per the baseline's own count -- tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.
**Go Fashion (India)** -- Q2 FY27 revenue slips 3% YoY to Rs 217.6 cr on a later festive calendar shifting LFS dispatches into Q3; gross margin eased to 60.8% on costlier fabric.
**Onesource Specialty Pharma** -- press release on OneSource receiving a USFDA EIR with VAI classification, completing an inspection; no revenue figure disclosed.
**Max Healthcare Institute** -- press release and presentation on its Q2 earnings update (figures carried in the Results tab, not repeated here).
**Royal Orchid Hotels** -- subsidiary Regenta Hotels opens a 37-room lifestyle hotel, Z by Regenta, in Vijayawada's Gandhi Nagar business district; no financial terms disclosed.
**LCC Projects** -- press release: Q2 FY27 revenue of Rs 885.7 cr, up 34% YoY, with an order book of Rs 8,146.6 cr (per the filing's own headline).
**Pudumjee Paper Products** -- press release: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin of 21% (per the filing's own headline; no revenue figure stated).
distress_risk: **Som Distilleries & Breweries** -- the Supreme Court reaffirms the High Court's order on renewal of the Company's manufacturing licences, a favourable outcome.
**Videocon Industries** -- pre-facto intimation of the 66th consolidated Committee of Creditors meeting of the Company and 12 other Videocon group entities, 3-Nov.
**Polycab India** -- NCLAT allows its appeal and sets aside the NCLT Ahmedabad order in the Asier Metals matter, a favourable outcome on litigation first disclosed in early October.
**Rajshree Sugars & Chemicals** -- the Commissioner of GST & Central Excise, Chennai, drops a Rs 62.84 cr molasses/CENVAT-credit demand (Apr-2014 to Jun-2017), Nil financial impact.
**BIL Vyapar (formerly Binani Industries)** -- postpones its 21st Committee of Creditors meeting by a day, from 29-Oct to 30-Oct.
**IL&FS Transportation Networks** -- defaults on Rs 6.70 cr of interest and part-principal due today on NCDs (ISIN INE975G08256, Tranche XX).
**MT Educare** -- discloses a continuing default (since Mar-2021) on Rs 32.33 cr of secured term-loan/overdraft borrowings from Axis Bank and Prudence ARC.
**Rallis India** -- the Bombay High Court's give-effect order drops a Rs 408 cr income-tax demand (AY2022-23), yielding a Rs 8.31 cr refund including Rs 1.79 cr interest, a favourable outcome.
credit_rating_changes: **Suzlon Energy** -- ICRA reaffirms its A+/A1 notches but revises the long-term outlook to Positive from Stable (facility size not published per house rule).
**Singer India** -- CRISIL upgrades its Rs 45 cr bank-facility ratings to BBB/Stable (from BBB-/Stable) and A3+ (from A3), facility size not published per house rule.
other_notable: **Medi Assist Healthcare Services** -- Board approves a tender-offer buyback of up to 11.59 lakh shares at Rs 425 each, Rs 49.27 cr.
**Transport Corporation of India** -- submits its Post Buyback Public Announcement, completing its tender-offer buyback of equity shares (Rs 150 cr; buyback opened 29-Sep).
**Global Education** -- submits its Public Announcement for an already-approved tender-offer buyback (Rs 23.89 cr); terms carried from the earlier record-date disclosure.
**Advanced Enzyme Technologies** -- intimates closure of its open-market buyback (approved 8-Aug, max size Rs 69.70 cr); final shares bought back not stated in the cached pages.
**Symphony** -- finalises the sale of its freehold vacant land at Bodakdev, Ahmedabad, for Rs 27.00 cr, against a Rs 5.68 cr carrying value; deed expected around 6-Nov.
